title: RAS & IEEE VNRVJIET SB in collaboration with RAS & SAC IEEE Hyderabad Section are conducting Robotics Innovation Hackathon 2026
description:
IEEE VNRVJIET SB in collaboration with RAS &SAC IEEE Hyderabad Section are conducting Robotics Innovation Hackathon 2026

We are excited to invite you to participate in the Robotics Innovation Hackathon 2026, a national-level, multi-stage competition organized under IEEE Robotics & Automation Society as part of ICMACC 2026.

This hackathon is designed to bring together innovative minds to design, prototype, and build intelligent robotic solutions for real-world challenges. With structured mentorship, hands-on learning, and access to expert guidance, participants will gain valuable experience in developing impactful hardware-based projects.

📅 Final Event Dates: November 5–7, 2026
👥 Team Size: 2–5 members (Interdisciplinary teams encouraged)

🔹 Multi-stage competition: Idea → Prototype → Final Demo
🔹 Domains include AI Robotics, Healthcare, Agriculture, Industrial Automation, and more
🔹 Opportunity for mentorship, networking, and exciting prizes

👉 Scan the QR code in the poster or use the link to register and learn more.

Join us to innovate, build, and make an impact through robotics.
